event_classes.meaning: confirmed transition from rise to fall
event_classes.name: TURN_DOWN

event_classes.meaning: no confirmed reversal at this bar
event_classes.name: NO_TURN

event_classes.meaning: confirmed transition from fall to rise
event_classes.name: TURN_UP

rules.candidate: a bar whose close is the strict minimum (TURN_UP) or maximum (TURN_DOWN) of the 3+3 bars around it
rules.disputed: a bar whose close ties the minimum or maximum of its window: excluded
rules.event_timestamp: timestamp of the bar being labelled
rules.gaps: a bar whose dependency span crosses a missing 1m bar: excluded, never filled
rules.insufficient_history: the first 17 bars of each symbol: excluded
rules.label_available_timestamp: timestamp 6 bars later, the last bar the label depends on
rules.no_confirmation: the last 6 bars of each symbol: excluded
rules.no_turn: a labelled bar that is not a kept candidate
rules.separation: a candidate is kept only if it is stronger than every candidate closer than 4 bars; weaker ones become NO_TURN
rules.significance: the smaller of the swings into and out of the candidate must reach 0.65 x the trailing 14-bar average true range
rules.turn_state: state after the latest kept turn; resets to NEUTRAL at each symbol start and after every excluded bar

state_classes.meaning: no confirmed turn since the last reset
state_classes.name: NEUTRAL
